unlisted_practices: Using LLMs in a human-in-the-loop framework to classify extraction errors and generate candidate rules to refine symbolic clinical NLP systems
Comparing four prompting conditions for LLM rule generation, including incorporating LLM-generated error reasoning into prompts

screen.reason: Evaluates a technical framework (REFINE) using LLMs to automatically generate symbolic rules for a clinical NLP system based on error analysis, but does not test organizational deployment practices or operational guardrails.
